recomputed_from: 100 NPZ traces with coordinate-level position/formation-error reconstruction
notes: Campaign/paper saturation uses abs(action)>=0.98. The nested historical controller.track_metrics diagnostic uses abs(action)>=1-1e-7; both definitions were verified separately and must not be mixed.

Constant leader truth positions are reconstructed from the first broadcast and exact action time; some later broadcast rows are sampled one 0.1-s integration substep after their nominal stored integer timestamp.
